summary: MediWound Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a shelf takedown under its Form F-3 (File No. 333-285908, effective March 27, 2025), not a special situation. On November 3, 2026 the company signed an underwriting agreement with H.C. Wainwright & Co. for 1,200,000 ordinary shares at $12.50 per share to the public, purchased by the underwriter at $12.09, reflecting a blended discount. The 30-day option for 180,000 additional shares was exercised in full on November 4, 2026. Gross proceeds of roughly $17.25 million are for working capital and general corporate purposes; closing expected November 5, 2026. A 60-day company lock-up and director/officer lock-ups apply. Watch for dilution and post-deal trading pressure rather than deal arbitrage.
